name: sqlalchemy-core
description: SQLAlchemy 2.1 Core Connection.begin() and Connection.begin_nested() through psycopg 3. No ORM Session. Category C faults are injected in this process, once, before Core sees the error. A top-level ROLLBACK is withheld on psycopg.Connection.rollback; ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT is withheld or rewritten in before_cursor_execute. TX-03's next unit of work is a second Engine.connect() and Connection.begin() on the same engine (pool_size 1, max_overflow 0).

modes.description: SQLAlchemy Core's Connection.begin() context manager, with Connection.begin_nested() for a savepoint. pool_size 1, max_overflow 0, pool_pre_ping off. TX-03's next unit of work is a second connection from that same engine. The engine is not disposed between the units. TX-05 sets isolation_level through Connection.execution_options before begin().

TX-04.independent-inner.reason: SQLAlchemy Core has no propagation modes and no deferred writes. Connection.begin_nested() is a SAVEPOINT on the same transaction, not an independent transaction. An independent transaction is a separate Connection.begin() on another checkout, which shares no pending writes with the outer one, so the hazard TX-04.3 targets (pending outer writes committed by the inner transaction) cannot arise.

MG-02.held.reason: SQLAlchemy Core's Engine and Connection expose no migration runner, history table, or reversal. Schema migration is not a contract of Core. Alembic is a separate project and is not this adapter.
